resources.string: The address you open Reel at in a browser: a LAN address such as 192.168.1.20:8420, a Tailscale address, or https://reel.example.com.
That isn\'t a web address. Try 192.168.1.20:8420 or https://reel.example.com.
%1$s answered, but it doesn\'t look like a Reel server.
Can\'t find %1$s. Check the name, or connect to the network or Tailscale it\'s on.
%1$s has a certificate this phone doesn\'t trust. Reel Web doesn\'t open servers with certificate errors.
Can\'t reach %1$s. If the server is only on your home network or Tailscale, connect to it and try again, or save the address anyway.
This phone has no network connection. Reel Web reconnects to %1$s as soon as it\'s back.
%1$s can\'t be found from this network. If it\'s a home or Tailscale address, connect to your home Wi-Fi or Tailscale.
%1$s refused the connection. Check that the Reel server is running and that the address and port are right.
%1$s didn\'t answer. Check that you\'re on your home network or Tailscale.
The connection to %1$s failed. Check that you\'re on your home network or Tailscale.
Android\'s web view never connects to port %1$d, which is reserved for other services. Run Reel on another port, such as 8420.
%1$s returned an error. Reel may be restarting.
The certificate of %1$s isn\'t valid for this phone, so Reel Web won\'t open it.
The web view closed unexpectedly. Reload to continue.
No app can open this link.
